title: Cannot rename files in Folder View widget shown inline on a thick panel
line: Renaming a file in a Folder View shown inline in a thick panel now works: what you type goes into the name field instead of KRunner.
explanation: Panels never take keyboard focus unless the containment's status is AcceptingInputStatus, and the Folder View's rename field never asked for it. So when the field opened in a Folder View shown inline in a panel, the keyboard stayed on the desktop and the typed text started a KRunner search; the file kept its name. The rename field now sets the applet's status to AcceptingInputStatus when it opens (or is clicked again after focus moved away) inside a window that doesn't accept focus, and drops it back to ActiveStatus when it loses focus.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: let the rename field take typing in panels

Panels don't take keyboard focus by default, so text typed into the
rename field of a Folder View shown inline in a panel went to the
desktop instead. Request input focus when the field opens or is clicked.

BUG: 524740

With the fix: same steps, 'zzq' replaces the selected 'aaa' in the rename field
With the fix: Enter renames the file to zzq.txt (panel list and desktop icon both updated)
